messages:
Alex: Heads up  launching a short paid burst for the product roadmap webinar next week. Need final rules: search pacing, retarget creative refresh, and lead webhook mapping. Goal: keep CPA within +/-10% and avoid cliffing on holiday Mon.

Priya: Proposal: reduce broad/non-branded bids by 14% weekdays, 20% holiday Mon. keep branded intact. apply daily-decrease cap 18% to avoid abrupt drops.

Marco: add hard floor = max(0.6 * current_bid, $0.45) and frequency cap for retarget = 3/day. retarget ttl = 21 days, exclude webinar_reg within 30d.

Alex: creative cadence: rotate 4 variants, swap every 48h. promote variant early if +18% CTR after 24h and at least 2000 impressions.

tracking-bot: UTMs set: utm_source=paid_webinar, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=roadmap_webinar_26, utm_content={{creative_id}}.

Marco: webhook path = /webhooks/marketing/webinar26. sample payload (send as JSON):
```
{ "lead_id":"W-2026","email":"sam@org.com","source":"paid_search","campaign":"roadmap_webinar_26","tags":["webinar_reg"] }
```

Priya: CRM mapping note: 'tags' -> multi_tag field, convert to comma-separated on ingest. 'lead_id' must be unique. I'll update import rules.

ads-bot: Campaign "Roadmap Webinar Burst" (id: 84299) created. daily_budget: $4,200.

Alex: action items:
- Priya: update pacing sheet + CRM mapping (EOD)
- Marco: implement bid-floor + daily cap and run dry-run at 09:30 PT
- Ops: confirm webhook accepts tags array and returns 200 in prod
- Growth: upload creatives and schedule 48h rotation

Marco: dry-run scheduled for 09:30 PT, will post results. :ok_hand:

Alex: thanks team  we'll monitor 15-min CPA alerts and decide on +$1k/day scale if stable after 48h. :rocket:
